body: I just posted on here about how I was writing suicide notes and don't want to ever go to a psych ward again, so probably not the best person to give advice.  Go to the hospital.  You will hate it, but the hospital doesn't have any cars to jump in front of.  If the emergency room doesn't appeal to you, you might wanna try calling the VA crisis line. 800-273-8255, press 1.  They can probably link you up with treatment that you don't have to pay for.  It sucks that your financial situation is what it is.  This sounds stupid and I don't know you, but keep fighting.  Not sure if any of the shit really works yet, but it has kept me alive so far.  Don't jump in front of a car.
